description: This file defines the 'Chart' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel's dashboard extension. It handles displaying the dashboard chart interface, saving configuration settings, and generating chart data via AJAX.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Controller class for managing the dashboard chart module, including rendering the configuration form, saving settings, and providing chart data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the dashboard chart configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs and fetching current configuration to view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard chart settings via POST request, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the view for the dashboard chart, with user token data.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: Generates and returns JSON data for charts based on selected time range, including customer and order data.
